name: Uyar Party
description:
About This Game

Uyar Party is a fast-paced multiplayer party game where every round throws you into a completely different kind of chaos.

Compete across colorful arenas, outplay your opponents, survive unpredictable hazards, and fight for the top spot across a collection of competitive minigames built for up to 8 players.

Play online with friends, challenge AI opponents, choose your favorite character, and jump straight into quick, chaotic matches where anything can happen.

EVERY ROUND PLAYS DIFFERENTLY

One moment you might be fighting to stay on a collapsing frozen arena. The next, you could be covering the map in your color, blasting opponents away, dodging dangerous hazards, racing for control of the arena, or simply trying to be the last player standing.

Every minigame introduces its own mechanics, objectives, arenas, hazards, and strategies, keeping each round easy to understand while giving you plenty of room to outplay your opponents.

No two challenges play quite the same.

PLAY WITH FRIENDS OR AI

Jump into online matches with friends or fill empty player slots with AI opponents and play at your own pace.

Whether you're competing seriously for first place or just causing as much chaos as possible, Uyar Party is built around short rounds, quick rematches, and unexpected moments that can completely turn a match around.

CHOOSE YOUR CHARACTER

Pick from a colorful roster of playable characters, each with their own personality and style.

Play matches, make progress, earn achievements, and customize your characters as you build up your profile and discover your favorites.

A PARTY FULL OF VARIETY

Uyar Party brings together different styles of competitive gameplay within one party game experience.

Battle your friends, survive chaotic arenas, master each minigame, chase high scores, and adapt when the rules completely change in the next round.

With additional minigames, characters, customization options, and other content expanding the experience throughout development, there is always another challenge waiting.

Pick your character. Enter the arena. And let the party begin.
short_desc: Uyar Party is a fast-paced multiplayer party game for up to 8 players. Compete across chaotic minigames, outplay your friends, survive unpredictable hazards, and fight for first place online or against AI.
